name: MADCASH-2 (Hubble)
blurb: MADCASH-2, a faint dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: madcash2-hubble
story: MADCASH-2 is a faint dwarf galaxy discovered near NGC 4214, a galaxy about as massive as the Large Magellanic Cloud. Most of its stars are ancient, but a small share formed far more recently.

claims.text: MADCASH-2 is a previously unknown faint dwarf galaxy near NGC 4214, a satellite of an LMC analog
NGC 4214 is a host galaxy of Large Magellanic Cloud stellar mass
MADCASH-2 contains mostly ancient, metal-poor stars, but some of its stellar mass formed much more recently
